104-3490-4659-8319.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4659-8319.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1385-4279-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1385-4279-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1563-2457-2557-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

997-2486-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-2486-4694-7306.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 1.

1957-4050-6772--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

728-803-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
728-803-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

628-7215-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

4417-7841-8089.description:
Activate Hex Parasite by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

5026-7683.notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable target(s) if needed.
5026-7683.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Reverberate's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Reverberate targeting the original Reverberate.
Resolve a copy of Reverberate, copying Reverberate targeting the original Reverberate.
Repeat step 4.

4399-4518-6097-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Hinterland Sanctifier trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-6097-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1263-2438-4871-6026.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5231-5542-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6145.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Passageway Seer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Passageway Seer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Passageway Seer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Passageway Seer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Passageway Seer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6145.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

876-4171-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Kozilek's Channeler.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Kozilek's Channeler.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Kozilek's Channeler.
Activate Kozilek's Channeler by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Kozilek's Channeler.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Kozilek's Channeler.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Kozilek's Channeler from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2079-3259-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
2079-3259-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
2079-3259-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

2617-7150-7715.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
2617-7150-7715.description:
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying The Mighty Thor's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of The Mighty Thor's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-3240-6462-7422.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

632-3621-4659-5129-7175.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3621-4659-5129-7175.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

803-1486-5433--119.easyPrerequisites: You control an untapped creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
803-1486-5433--119.description:
Tap a creature using any method.
Magda triggers, as the creature is a Dwarf due to Arcane Adaptation, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token and giving it haste until end of turn.
Repeat, tapping the Goblin instead.
803-1486-5433--119.notes: The method used to tap creatures must be usable for all creatures you control for the loop to continue. You may use Krenko (or Magda if it doesn't have summoning sickness) to start the combo if they're untapped. Some methods may overt the summoning sickness requirement (like Earthcraft, for example).

338-3197-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3197-4506.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2919-4186-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-4186-4268.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1981-4416-5789-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1981-4416-5789-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4499-4747-6633.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

527-542-969.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-969.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1497-3139-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-3139-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

3812-3814-5963.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
3812-3814-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Argothian Elder's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands you control.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1992-5256-5994.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-5256-5994.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight token enters the battlefield, Securitron Squadron triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Knight.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

2061-2239-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2061-2239-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

1405-2034-2923.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
1405-2034-2923.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scourge of the Throne, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

643-1379-1558-4338.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five other creatures.
643-1379-1558-4338.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Clerics due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

406-1339-2804.easyPrerequisites: Tandem Lookout paired with Witty Roastmaster.
406-1339-2804.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
406-1339-2804.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Witty Roastmaster, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Witty Roastmaster triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-2033-4786-5077-5310.notablePrerequisites:
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one creature except Bloodghast and Scaretiller that does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one land.
1636-2033-4786-5077-5310.description:
Activate any creature you control except Bloodghast or Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Claws of Gix twice by paying {2} and sacrificing Bloodghast and a land, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning a land to the battlefield from your graveyard tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Bloodghast enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2034-2998-4231-5003.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
2034-2998-4231-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gluttonous Troll, adding {C}{C}.
Gluttonous Troll dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Gluttonous Troll from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Gluttonous Troll enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Food, three Clue and three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

372-3908-4089.description:
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Spark Double leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Glasspool Mimic returns from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Spark Double.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Spark Double until Glasspool Mimic leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Spark Double leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glasspool Mimic until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Glasspool Mimic leaves the battlefield, Spark Double returns to the battlefield from exile as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

3099-3767-4289-4893.notablePrerequisites: You control a Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
3099-3767-4289-4893.description:
Activate any Sliver by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate the tapped Sliver by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of mana, you may use it to activate Leyline of Abundance, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3459-4474-5078-5243.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1872-1953-2011-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Composite Golem.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token, then causing each token you control to become a copy of the Composite Golem token.
Activate the Myr by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

225-539-765-1993.notablePrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
225-539-765-1993.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Budoka Gardener as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
